content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I hope this email finds you well. I am looking forward to working together, and I have just a few small suggestions regarding the agreement before I sign it.

- Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable Net 60. An invoice that remains unpaid after the due date may accrue interest at 1.0% per month to the extent permitted by applicable law.", payment is due in 60 days, which exceeds the standard 30-day term and delays your cash flow. I propose modifying this to state that invoices are payable Net 30.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Best regards,
